description: This file defines data structures, constants, and functions for managing custom profile attributes in the Mattermost platform, including validation, serialization, and patching logic.

classes.name: CustomProfileAttributesSelectOption
classes.description: Represents an option for a custom profile attribute, including validation logic.

classes.name: CPAField
classes.description: Represents a custom profile attribute field with methods for validation, patching, and conversion.

classes.name: CPAAttrs
classes.description: Holds attribute properties for a CPAField, including visibility, options, and data types.

methods.name: IsKnownCPAValueType
methods.description: Checks if a given value type string is recognized.

methods.name: IsKnownCPAVisibility
methods.description: Checks if a given visibility string is recognized.

methods.name: GetID
methods.description: Returns the ID of a CustomProfileAttributesSelectOption.

methods.name: GetName
methods.description: Returns the name of a CustomProfileAttributesSelectOption.

methods.name: SetID
methods.description: Sets the ID of a CustomProfileAttributesSelectOption.

methods.name: IsSynced
methods.description: Determines if the CPAField is synchronized with external sources.

methods.name: IsAdminManaged
methods.description: Checks if the CPAField is managed by an admin.

methods.name: SetDefaults
methods.description: Sets default values for a CPAField.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Applies a patch to a CPAField, converting to PropertyField, applying the patch, and converting back.

methods.name: ToPropertyField
methods.description: Converts a CPAField to a PropertyField.

methods.name: SupportsOptions
methods.description: Checks if the CPAField type supports options.

methods.name: SupportsSyncing
methods.description: Checks if the CPAField type supports syncing with external sources.

methods.name: SanitizeAndValidate
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes a CPAField's attributes.

methods.name: NewCPAFieldFromPropertyField
methods.description: Creates a CPAField from a PropertyField.

methods.name: SanitizeAndValidatePropertyValue
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes a property value based on the CPAField type.
